items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Heywood is somebody who'd just gotten busted. I think he'd gotten busted in California somewhere.

ctx.x: Anyway, about the middle of the week, we go to these doctors in this building. I didn't know what that was all about. But I went in there, and there was a big table with these guys sitting up there with the braid(?) and everything, and they started asking me questions about how I felt about the Navy and the Armed Service, and this and that. So I just gave them some straight answers about how I felt about everything. And they looked at my thing and said, "You're a musician." "Yeah." "Where you working?" I told him.

About that time, I think somewhere around in there... Eddie Heywood is somebody who'd just gotten busted. I think he'd gotten busted in California somewhere.
